item.text: The packet has 60 items across three query families. I’m preserving all packs tied at the latest earlier meeting and including historical CRs regardless of disposition status. The schema leaves some stored values unspecified; I’ll note those uncertainties in the report.

item.command:
/bin/bash -lc "python3 - <<'PY'
import json
import re

with open('packet.json', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    packet = json.load(f)

def quote(value):
    return \"'\" + value.replace(\"'\", \"''\") + \"'\"

common = '''WITH pack_edges AS (
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM cr_in_pack
    UNION
    SELECT cr, pack_id FROM pack_member
), section_edges AS (
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM cr_modifies_section
    UNION
    SELECT cr, section_id FROM section_modified_by
), documents AS (
    SELECT id, number,
           REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(target_release)), 'rel-', '') AS release_key
    FROM document
), sections AS (
    SELECT id, spec, clause,
           REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM(release)), 'rel-', '') AS release_key
    FROM section
)'''

def verified(disposition_alias, meeting_alias):
    return f'''REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM({disposition_alias}.evidence_status)), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') = 'source_verified'
      AND REPLACE(REPLACE(LOWER(TRIM({disposition_alias}.scope)), '-', '_'), ' ', '_') IN ('document', 'whole_document')
      AND REPLACE(UPPER(TRIM({meeting_alias}.wg)), ' ', '') = 'RAN1' '''.rstrip()

history = '''historical AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT s.spec, s.release_key, s.clause,
           p.pack_number, p.tsg_meeting, p.tsg_number
    FROM documents AS d
    JOIN section_edges AS se ON se.cr = d.id
    JOIN sections AS s ON s.id = se.section_id
                           AND s.release_key = d.release_key
    JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.cr = d.id
    JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pe.pack_id
)'''

records = []
family_counts = {'previous': 0, 'first': 0, 'other_crs': 0}
for item in packet['items']:
    question = item['question']
    releases = list(dict.fromkeys(re.findall(r'Rel-(\\d+)', question)))
    assert releases
    release_values = ', '.join(quote(value) for value in releases)
    if question.startswith('TSG RAN CR pack '):
        pack_number = re.search(r'RP-\\d+', question).group(0)
        seed = f'''seed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS document, s.spec, s.release_key,
           s.clause, p.tsg_number
    FROM cr_pack AS p
    JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.pack_id = p.id
    JOIN documents AS d ON d.id = pe.cr
    JOIN section_edges AS se ON se.cr = d.id
    JOIN sections AS s ON s.id = se.section_id
                           AND s.release_key = d.release_key
    WHERE p.pack_number = {quote(pack_number)}
      AND d.release_key IN ({release_values})
      AND EXISTS (
          SELECT 1
          FROM disposition AS dp
          JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
          JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
          WHERE dp.target = d.id
            AND {verified('dp', 'm')}
      )
)'''
        prefix = common + ', ' + seed + ', ' + history
        if 'Keep the clauses that the pack changes first:' in question:
            family = 'first'
            sql = prefix + '''
SELECT DISTINCT b.document AS document,
       b.spec AS specification,
       b.clause AS clause
FROM seed AS b
WHERE NOT EXISTS (
    SELECT 1
    FROM historical AS h
    WHERE h.spec = b.spec
      AND h.release_key = b.release_key
      AND h.clause = b.clause
      AND h.tsg_number < b.tsg_number
);'''
            expected = ['document', 'specification', 'clause']
        else:
            assert 'latest earlier TSG RAN meeting' in question
            family = 'previous'
            sql = prefix + '''
SELECT DISTINCT b.spec AS specification,
       b.clause AS clause,
       previous_pack.pack_number AS cr_pack,
       previous_pack.tsg_meeting AS tsg_meeting
FROM seed AS b
JOIN historical AS previous_pack
  ON previous_pack.spec = b.spec
 AND previous_pack.release_key = b.release_key
 AND previous_pack.clause = b.clause
WHERE previous_pack.tsg_number = (
    SELECT MAX(h.tsg_number)
    FROM historical AS h
    WHERE h.spec = b.spec
      AND h.release_key = b.release_key
      AND h.clause = b.clause
      AND h.tsg_number < b.tsg_number
);'''
            expected = ['specification', 'clause', 'cr_pack', 'tsg_meeting']
    else:
        assert question.startswith('Change request ')
        family = 'other_crs'
        document_number = re.search(r'R1-\\d+', question).group(0)
        assert len(releases) == 1
        sql = common + f''', seed AS (
    SELECT DISTINCT d.number AS seed_document, s.spec,
           s.release_key, s.clause
    FROM documents AS d
    JOIN section_edges AS se ON se.cr = d.id
    JOIN sections AS s ON s.id = se.section_id
                           AND s.release_key = d.release_key
    WHERE d.number = {quote(document_number)}
      AND d.release_key IN ({release_values})
)
SELECT DISTINCT b.clause AS clause,
       other_document.number AS document,
       dp.code AS disposition,
       m.label AS wg_meeting,
       p.pack_number AS cr_pack
FROM seed AS b
JOIN sections AS s ON s.spec = b.spec
                      AND s.release_key = b.release_key
                      AND s.clause = b.clause
JOIN section_edges AS se ON se.section_id = s.id
JOIN documents AS other_document ON other_document.id = se.cr
                                    AND other_document.release_key = b.release_key
JOIN disposition AS dp ON dp.target = other_document.id
JOIN resolution AS r ON r.id = dp.resolution_id
JOIN meeting AS m ON m.id = r.meeting_id
JOIN pack_edges AS pe ON pe.cr = other_document.id
JOIN cr_pack AS p ON p.id = pe.pack_id
WHERE other_document.number <> b.seed_document
  AND {verified('dp', 'm')};'''
        expected = ['clause', 'document', 'disposition', 'wg_meeting', 'cr_pack']
    assert item['fields'] == expected, item['id']
    assert sql.startswith('WITH ')
    assert not re.search(r'\\b(?:INSERT|UPDATE|DELETE|CREATE|DROP|ALTER|PRAGMA|ATTACH)\\b', sql, re.IGNORECASE)
    final_projection = sql[sql.rfind('\\nSELECT DISTINCT '):].split('\\nFROM ', 1)[0]
    aliases = re.findall(r'\\bAS\\s+(\\w+)', final_projection, re.IGNORECASE)
    assert aliases == item['fields'], (item['id'], aliases)
    records.append({'id': item['id'], 'sql': sql})
    family_counts[family] += 1

with open('queries.jsonl', 'w', encoding='utf-8') as f:
    for record in records:
        f.write(json.dumps(record, ensure_ascii=False) + '\\n')
print('Lines written:', len(records))
print('Family counts:', json.dumps(family_counts))
PY"
